She let us make our own decision, and we thank her again... we recommend this clinic to anyone whose pet has a health problem; they will be loved and very well cared for. Thank you again.
Excellent Cabinet!

Strongly discouraged! Very bad experience with the on-call vet on the night of July 30, 2026.

Our cat had been taken to this clinic the previous day, and his condition wasn't improving. We were very worried and simply called twice to find out if he needed to be hospitalized. Instead of being reassuring, attentive, or even remotely professional, the vet spoke to us in an extremely harsh, cold, and aggressive tone. We felt like we were bothering her and being treated as if our concern was illegitimate.

We then decided to go to another emergency clinic, as the interaction made us feel so uncomfortable. We needed to get the images and results of the tests done the day before to ensure continuity of care for our cat. Again, it was very difficult to get a response: the phone was no longer answering despite several attempts.

What was particularly shocking was the complete lack of empathy shown to owners worried about their pet, which was still unwell. We weren't asking for free treatment or special attention: just information, advice on the necessity of hospitalization, and access to the test results already obtained.

The veterinarian seemed primarily intent on discouraging us from coming, while speaking to us in a very unpleasant manner. When you contact an emergency service because your pet is sick and you're scared, you should be listened to and given information without feeling like you're a problem.

We ultimately decided to go to a different emergency service. A very disappointing experience, especially given the already stressful situation.
Very friendly

An emergency consultation costing €270 for my dog ​​Texas, who was suffering from a herniated disc, a serious condition that can lead to paralysis. During this consultation, the veterinarian unfortunately forgot to prescribe gabapentin, which is essential for her treatment and which I had specifically requested.

Mistakes happen, that's not what I'm complaining about. What I regret is that I'm being criticized for your lack of response to my emails and calls. When I finally found myself without treatment and called the clinic back on July 11th, I was told that I should have "waked up sooner" and insisted more on getting a prescription. I found this remark particularly inappropriate.

I can understand that a veterinarian might want to see my dog ​​again before prescribing medication several months later. That's why I offered a free consultation, as this situation resulted from an initial oversight by the clinic. This proposal was refused, and the person on the phone refused to acknowledge that a mistake had been made, claiming it wasn't their fault. I wasn't looking for someone to blame, but simply a solution.

I was eventually told to wait about ten days, until the clinic manager returned from vacation. Unfortunately, when your dog is out of medication, waiting ten days is simply not an option.

My dog ​​has already had surgery for a herniated disc, and it's essential for me to always have her medication available. Behind this lack of consideration is an animal in pain.

Ultimately, it was thanks to my former veterinarian and a pharmacist that I was able to obtain the gabapentin she needed.

I'm very disappointed, not by the initial mistake, which can happen, but by the way it was handled. A little more listening, kindness, and a willingness to find a solution would have made all the difference.

Madam,

We are sincerely sorry to see your dissatisfaction reflected in this review.

At our clinic, every animal receives the utmost care, and medical decisions are always guided by its health and well-being. When an animal is brought to us as an emergency, our priority is to examine it, ensure its stability, and implement the most appropriate treatment plan.

Out of respect for professional secrecy and the confidentiality of medical records, we will not publicly comment on the details of the consultation. However, we wish to emphasize that our team acted in accordance with best veterinary practices, with all the care and professionalism that every patient deserves.

We regret that your experience led you to give us this review, especially since no comments allow us to understand the precise reasons for your dissatisfaction. If you would like to discuss your experience further or obtain an explanation, we are, of course, available to talk directly.

Sincerely,

The Univet Wagranville Veterinary Clinic Team

She is very attentive, takes the time to perform the necessary examinations, and clearly explains her observations and recommendations. The care is of high quality and the follow-up is very thorough. My rabbit has been doing much better since I started seeing her. I recommend her without hesitation!

My sincere thanks, especially to Anna Furst from the exotic pets section. She was incredibly professional, kind, and gentle, and she operated on my hamster Major Tom's abscess without causing him any trauma. He's doing wonderfully today. You can go to this clinic with complete confidence.

Salto has been followed by the clinic since the beginning, and the staff has always been very attentive and efficient in addressing his various health issues.
I highly recommend them.
A huge thank you to the on-call vet and the daytime team who took care of our cat in an emergency last week. Thanks to them, our cat has many more good years ahead of him.

Excellent service, and they don't just focus on performing the requested procedure (vaccination, etc.). They conduct a thorough clinical examination of the animal, which is definitely not the case with other clinics!
I highly recommend them!
Thank you for this very positive feedback! We will do everything we can to maintain this rating! 😄 The team at your Univet Wagranville Veterinary Clinic …

I am always calm during Doudou's visits because, being fearful and afraid of men, Dr. ATTALI's gentleness reassures him, which allows the consultation to be completed peacefully (despite the injections).

The team is very attentive, responsive, and efficient.
They all have a wonderful relationship with my kitten and always answer my questions and address my concerns.

(This was also the case a few years ago for my cat who lived to be 18 and a half.)

This clinic is adequate for routine care (vaccinations, checkups), but I strongly advise against it for emergencies.

My cat was treated there for a critical week without any improvement. We felt a profound lack of expertise and support.

The team seems constantly understaffed, and the hospitalization conditions are poor: the kennels are very cramped for the animals and of lower quality than in other clinics.

Faced with this situation, I transferred my cat to another facility that was able to stabilize him in just two days.

Unfortunately, the initial delay in treatment was already too much to overcome. Despite our efforts, it was too late, and my cat passed away. Do not entrust your distressed animals to this clinic; the lack of responsiveness and resources is appalling.

A huge thank you to the clinic, the nurses, and the doctors who took the best possible care of my beloved Titou.

And thank you for continuing to support grieving owners deeply affected by loss, like myself.
Thank you for answering all my questions and for being there for us during this difficult time.

WARNING — No emergency service despite the signs!

It is advertised as a 24/7 emergency clinic, but this is completely false! A sign on the door indicates that emergencies close at 10 PM, but even this is not respected.
We arrived today at 8 PM with a life-threatening emergency (our dog suffered angioedema following a vaccination). The door was locked, and no one answered our numerous phone calls!
If we had known that the service was nonexistent, we would never have come here. Such a waste of time can cost an animal its life! It is unacceptable and dangerous to claim to offer emergency care without providing 24/7 service. Avoid this place if you care about your pet.

Honestly, when you go to the emergency vet at midnight and pay €140 for a consultation, you expect to be seen by an experienced veterinarian, not a junior (or even an intern).

The vet was seriously inexperienced and couldn't diagnose the cause of my cat's collapse after vomiting. We now know it was most likely a vasovagal syncope, not a heart murmur.

I'm not questioning the young vet's competence, but rather the responsibility of the clinic's management. There's a real lack of reliability and professionalism in the care they provided.

If my cat's life had been in danger, the consequences could have been disastrous.

I absolutely do not recommend this clinic for an emergency.
👍🏻 I highly recommend this clinic; the vet is very attentive and helpful. Thank you for taking care of my Katy. …

I brought my hamster in last night because of a problem with paralyzed lower limbs.
The vet took his pulse, which seemed normal. She suggested an X-ray to see exactly what was wrong before making a decision.

Nothing was broken on his spine, but he had swelling at the back of his neck, though she said it wasn't abnormal. She suggested a 5-6 day treatment protocol. My daughter woke up this morning to find her hamster dead. I've thrown away €250, but more importantly, my daughter is devastated. I wish they had told me there was nothing to be done and that euthanasia was the best option.

A special thank you to Dr. Alexia Buyse, who has been treating my dog ​​for years. Her competence, gentleness, and ability to clearly explain each step of the treatment make all the difference. You can tell she deeply loves animals and takes the time needed for each one.
Thanks to her and the entire team, my dog ​​has always been in excellent hands. A trustworthy, compassionate, and highly reputable clinic.
Welcoming and very professional staff; good rapport with animals

Very disappointing clinic. Never again.

My cat has been seen at this clinic since he was one year old (vaccinations only) because of its location.

I came in as an emergency one morning because my cat had vomited seven times, wasn't eating, drinking, or urinating for 24 hours. The vet, whom I had already seen for a vaccination, is completely afraid of cats (the height of irony for a vet!), even though mine is a sweetheart, just timid. She barely acknowledged him and just gave me an anti-nausea medication. I was charged €300 for the consultation!!

The next day, seeing that my cat's condition wasn't improving, I took him to an emergency clinic on Christmas Eve. He was seen by a fantastic vet who immediately identified the problem: my cat's bladder had been extremely distended for 48 hours (something Wagranville wasn't even able to detect!), causing urinary stones. He had to be rushed to the hospital and put on a feeding tube and IV for three days, and he's still not recovering.

This is the second time I've seen this vet who's afraid of cats, receiving comments like, "Wow, he seems nice," or "Next time, give him a sedative before coming to see us." I find it shameful.

It's a shame, because this was my go-to clinic, but what happened to my cat has made me realize how important it is to choose your vet carefully to protect the life of a loved one.

I absolutely do not recommend this clinic.
A very warm welcome for my old golden retriever who needed to have stitches removed after surgery in London, as his usual vet was unavailable. Thank you so much for being there for us.
Efficiency and kindness. Perfect.

I was very disappointed with the care my cat received during an emergency consultation in November.

We came in for a serious eye problem, and the diagnosis we were given there seemed understated. We were told it might be conjunctivitis and advised to wait several days before consulting a specialist if it didn't improve.

The very next day, our cat's condition worsened significantly, and our regular veterinarian diagnosed a much more serious condition requiring urgent care. Despite her prompt intervention, our cat ultimately had to have her eyes enucleated a few days later.

We tried to resolve the situation amicably with the clinic, but we found no understanding or consideration for what we had experienced.

I am sharing this review to share our experience and the facts as we saw them, hoping that it will lead to better treatment of pet owners and clearer communication with the staff in the future.

Excellent, compassionate veterinarians who provide very good care for the animal (and the owners 😁) with kindness, attentiveness, and helpful advice. As a client for over 30 years, I know this clinic very well.

I highly recommend them.
